en: Black‑and‑white view from an elevated lookout with a curved metal railing and a bust statue in the foreground, looking over a small European town nestled in a wooded valley. In the middle distance stands a large, ornate 19th‑century institutional or civic building, flanked by smaller houses with steep gabled roofs. On a hill above the town is a tall church with a simple steeple and lancet windows. The landscape is hilly and heavily forested, and there is a river or stream running through the valley. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image side.
